rationale: Overcomes the -$10,999 cash deficit by lifting the land-labor ceiling to 18-20 contiguous plots matched to 10-11 hands by Day 15, avoiding the labor idling that capped candidate cash at ~$118k. It remedies the catastrophic failure of Gen 51-53 by replacing the premature Day-18 carrot pivot with a calibrated Day-23 Strawberry cutoff (retaining 2-3 high-value compounding harvests) and instituting a smooth two-tier surplus liquidation (>=6 items early, >=8-10 items post-Day 7 at >=0.80x floor) to prevent early cash starvation. Finally, it enforces crop-growth duration feasibility gating on Town Shop contracts to stop stranded slow crops, eliminates the ruinous 0.60x panic dump, and embeds an in-situ harvest-then-water execution pipeline that eliminates plot dry-intervals.
